name: Torero Aesthetic
summary: The Torero aesthetic is a style in art and fashion derived from the traditional attire and pageantry of bullfighters ( toreros ) in Spain.
description: The Torero aesthetic is a style in art and fashion derived from the traditional attire and pageantry of bullfighters ( toreros ) in Spain. The aesthetic is defined by its highly ornate and symbolic garments, most notably the traje de luces ("suit of lights"). While it has had a significant influence on fine art and haute couture for centuries, the style is inseparable from the practice of bullfighting, a subject of major ethical controversy. [ 1 ] This page documents the aesthetic's visual components and historical context.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Tradition, bravery, pageantry, honor, tragedy
